notes: Manufacturer spec sheet (MCAT 230G-0223, williamsav.com) covers a 4-model family: DL107 NET (single loop output, base model used here), DL107 NET D (adds a Dante RJ-45 input, 100Mbps/24-bit/44.1-48kHz, on the same 1RU chassis), DL207 NET and DL207 NET D (dual-output siblings with an added "Loop Out B" terminal block). All physical port labels above are taken from the rear-panel silkscreen photo in the spec sheet (MIC/LINE IN 1, LINE IN 2, 70-100V IN, LINE OUT BAL/UNBAL, LOOP OUT A, STATUS RELAY NC/COM/NO, USB, ETHERNET) plus the front-panel headphone jack. Terminal-block inputs/outputs (Line In 2, 70-100V In, Line Out, Loop Out, Status Relay) are pluggable 2- or 3-position spring/screw terminal blocks — mapped to "euroblock" as the closest connector id in the allowed list (not a barrier/DC block, so not euroblock-dc). USB grade is inferred/approximated: spec states "USB 1.1, 2.0 or 3.0 supported" without specifying which speed is standard, so usb-5g (USB3.0 SuperSpeed) was chosen as the ceiling — treat as medium-confidence on that one field only. Ethernet is 10/100Base-T control-only (not an audio/AV data link). This is a hearing-loop (assistive listening) amplifier, not a general PA amp — "Loop Out" drives an induction loop antenna, not a speaker.

ports.name: Ethernet
ports.note: 10/100Base-T, for DigiLoop PC App network control/configuration

ports.name: USB
ports.note: USB 1.1/2.0/3.0 supported (firmware updates only); grade set to highest supported spec (USB 3.0/SuperSpeed)

ports.name: Mic/Line In 1
ports.note: Configurable Mic or Line (-10dBV/+4dBu/+8dBu), balanced or unbalanced, 24V phantom in mic mode

ports.name: Line In 2
ports.note: 3-position terminal block, 10k ohm, configurable level, balanced or unbalanced

ports.name: 70-100V In
ports.note: 2-position terminal block; accepts 25V/70V/100V high-level input from distributed speaker/paging systems

ports.name: Line Out
ports.note: 3-position terminal block, +4dBu balanced/unbalanced; loop-through mirror of loop output audio

ports.name: Loop Out A
ports.note: 2-position terminal block; 9.5 Arms/13.4 Apk continuous, 16.1 Vrms/22.8 Vpk drive to inductive hearing loop

ports.name: Headphone
ports.note: Front-panel 1/4" stereo jack, monitors selectable input or output

ports.name: Status Relay (Loop Fault)
ports.note: 3-position terminal block: NC, COM, NO dry-contact relay (2.0A @ 30VDC), triggers on loop fault
